title: JLPT N5 Grammar — Particles and Basics
description: Core N5 particles, verb forms, and sentence patterns.

questions.question: わたし___がくせいです。
questions.explanation: は marks the topic: "As for me, (I) am a student."

questions.question: パン___食べます。
questions.explanation: を marks the direct object: "(I) eat bread."

questions.question: 学校___行きます。
questions.explanation: に marks the destination: "(I) go to school." へ also works for direction.

questions.question: 図書館___本を読みます。
questions.explanation: で marks the place where an action happens: "(I) read books at the library."

questions.question: ねこ___すきです。
questions.explanation: 好きです takes が for the liked thing: "(I) like cats."

questions.question: わたし___学生です。妹も学生です。
questions.explanation: The first topic uses は; も ("also") appears in the second sentence about the younger sister.

questions.question: What does 食べません mean?
questions.explanation: ません is the polite negative: 食べません = do not / will not eat.

questions.question: What does 行きました mean?
questions.explanation: ました is the polite past: 行きました = went.

questions.question: What does 高かったです mean?
questions.explanation: i-adjectives form the past with 〜かったです: 高かったです = it was expensive.

questions.question: What does 食べませんでした mean?
questions.explanation: ませんでした is the polite past negative: did not eat.

questions.question: What does これ mean?
questions.explanation: これ = this (near the speaker), それ = that (near the listener), あれ = that over there.

questions.question: What does the particle から do in 「高いですから、買いません。」?
questions.explanation: から after a clause gives the reason: "Because it is expensive, (I) won't buy it."

questions.question: Translate 「わたしは学生です。」 into English.
questions.reading: わたしはがくせいです
questions.explanation: わたし = I, は = topic marker, 学生 = student, です = am.

questions.question: Translate 「ともだちと映画を見ました。」 into English.
questions.reading: ともだちとえいがをみました
correctAnswers: I watched a movie with a friend
I watched a film with a friend
watched a movie with a friend
questions.explanation: ともだちと = with a friend, 映画を = movie (object), 見ました = watched.
